name: How should I prepare before starting a kitchen addition project?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before starting a kitchen addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an initial consultation, clarify your primary goals, gather property records, and establish a comfortable budget range. Determine what you lack in your current kitchen, such as storage, counter space, or dining seating, and decide whether you want to expand into your backyard or side yard. Having your property survey or plot plan on hand helps confirm boundary lines and utility easements. It is also practical to collect layout ideas and note appliance preferences, which helps the contractor plan plumbing lines, vent placement, and electrical load requirements early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clarify your layout goals, identify necessary functional improvements, gather any property surveys, and decide on a clear budget range and appliance preferences.
